items.summary: After October CPI rose to 6.09% from 5.54%, SBI Research cut its December call from 50 bp to 25 bp, citing a steadier rupee, foreign inflows and softer crude, and sees the repo rate topping out near 6% (with a 50:50 chance of 5.75%). Union Bank of India also expects 25 bp to 5.75% but does not rule out a 'one and done' 50 bp, and says November inflation is tracking near 6.3%; Bank of Baroda's chief economist sees 25–50 bp.

items.whyItMatters: The size of the December hike sets loan and deposit rates for banks, NBFCs and real estate for the next several quarters.
